title: Can ride
prompt: You can ride the roller coaster if you are at least 120 cm tall OR you are with an adult. Return true if the person can ride.

tests.name: 100 cm with an adult may ride

hints: or is true if either side is true.

docs.what: Comparisons. Each gives true or false.

docs.name: and  or  not
docs.what: and is true when both sides are; or when at least one is; not flips true and false.

solution:
func can_ride(height_cm, with_adult):
	return height_cm >= 120 or with_adult
